name: Canvas Board: Excalidraw Whiteboard Suite
description: Infinite canvas & visual whiteboard plugin for EdgeEver with full Excalidraw integration: Native new note type in dropdown menu, freehand doodles, eraser, shapes, custom palettes, libraries, and 100% offline auto-persistence.

zh-CN.name: Canvas Board: Excalidraw 手绘白板与架构画布
zh-CN.description: 为 EdgeEver 带来原生的 Excalidraw 手绘矢量白板与思维画布。无缝集成至左侧边栏「更多类型 ▾」新建菜单中，提供全套手绘涂鸦压感画笔、橡皮擦、几何图形、调色板、开源素材库，数据 100% 离线静默自动保存至笔记。
